name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio: Klaus-Dieter's career started in the rather less glamorous world of auditing for a mid-sized manufacturing firm, but his passion for motorsport always simmered beneath the surface. After years of crunching numbers and longing for the roar of engines, he took a leap of faith, leveraging his financial acumen to land a role in motorsport finance. He's meticulous and data-driven, believing that every financial decision should be backed by rigorous analysis. Klaus-Dieter's not afraid to challenge the status quo, often suggesting innovative budgeting strategies to improve team efficiency and resource allocation. His relentless pursuit of financial stability makes him a crucial asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Klaus-Dieter has a serious demeanor and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Insists on using a vintage mechanical calculator for important calculations alongside the computer.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk, each representing a significant financial milestone achieved.
Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten financial projections.
